text_block_list.text: Early one morning—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainer.
It's rare to run into you at this hour.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the weather is so lovely
that it would be a waste not to run.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this weather will last all day.
It truly is the perfect day for training!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'd better get ready for school soon.
Well then, see you at training time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I plan to do plenty of intensive running,
so make sure you're ready for it too!

And when it was time for training,
however—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Why are you still in your uniform?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
About that, why don't we train in the pool
today instead?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I really think it's important to
train your body in a well-balanced way, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Or classroom study works for me too. Knowledge is indispensable when it comes to running, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: I thought you were running because the weather was nice...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I-I just changed my mind!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Running is important, of course.
I also believe you grow by as much distance as you cover.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But you know! Having a broad perspective in everything opens up so many possibilities!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There are things I never would've realized just by running...
I might just find a whole new me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Being first-rate means never settling for the present
and constantly pursuing a new and better self!!
choice_data_list: I see, you might have a point.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
Naturally, naturally!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Whether it's the pool or classroom study,
we're doing anything except running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, King-chan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but if you're asking for a sparring partner, I can't help you.
I just decided I'm not running today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's what I thought.
For a second, I wondered if you were going to run in your uniform.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, you mentioned this morning that you 'washed all your tracksuits,' so—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!? Why did you have to go and stick your nose in...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! It's nothing!
It's nothing at all, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't just stand around dazed, let's go!
To find a brand new you!
choice_data_list: Let's focus on training other than running!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes you King's Trainer!
We can run anytime, except right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... I could lend you a tracksuit if you want...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm doing this just 'cause I don't have a jersey!
Training other than running is important too, you know!

King Halo adamantly insisted on keeping
a broad perspective in her training.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not true! It's not like I accidentally put
all my jerseys into the washing machine at once or anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If you want me to run that badly,
fine! Just wait while I go get changed!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come on, I'll run as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It gets me much more fired up this way! Come,
join me for a tandem run, Special Week-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaah!? W-Wait for me~!
Whether due to the clear weather or something else entirely, King Halo ran with everything she had.
